backup.production_rule: verified_at is the backup creation time. Additive: two new tables, one trigger function attached to six tables, eight new functions, transactions.txn_type check widened to allow 'drawing'. No data touched. Apply within one hour of the backup or take a new one.

forward_verification.name: six_audit_triggers_exist
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 6 from pg_trigger where tgname = 'admin_audit_row' and not tgisinternal

forward_verification.name: txn_type_allows_drawing
forward_verification.query: select pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%drawing%' from pg_constraint where conname = 'transactions_txn_type_check'

forward_verification.name: audit_log_rls_on
forward_verification.query: select relrowsecurity from pg_class where oid = 'public.admin_audit_log'::regclass

forward_verification.name: eight_functions_present
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 8 from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and p.proname in ('admin_audit_context_v1','admin_table_action_v1','admin_soft_delete_v1','admin_undo_v1','admin_save_transaction_v1','review_meter_reading_v1','admin_audit_feed_v1','run_health_checks_v1')

forward_verification.name: existing_ledger_totals_untouched
forward_verification.query: select (select sum(gross_amount) from public.transactions where source = 'airbnb_payout_email' and status = 'confirmed') = 343495.13

rollback.safe_until: any 'drawing' transaction row is written; after that retype or void those rows first, then the script drops everything the migration added

feature_flags.name: admin_rollout_modules
feature_flags.required_state: app/src/lib/rollout.ts maps admin_save_transaction_v1 to finance, admin_soft_delete_v1 and admin_undo_v1 to operations, review_meter_reading_v1 to readiness; all six modules enabled since 2026-09-13.

compatibility.evidence: Additive only. The legacy admin and every Edge Function keep writing income/expense rows unchanged; the audit trigger records those writes with a null actor. Not rehearsed on Alfred: the migration is transactional and the eight forward checks run before commit is trusted.

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour
admin_audit_log already contains rows before this release (a previous partial apply)
